upstream: hexstrike-ai (0x4m4), pinned d689933 — vendored NON-runnable; 79 distinct external tools
note: fact_capable is set ONLY when a runner-owned oracle re-drive exists AND the ToolSpec passes the conformance battery (live.conformance). Everything else is LEAD-only or excluded. The count that matters is fact_capable, not the upstream tool count. Two FACT families are VIGIL-DIRECT (no tool is the authority): VERSION_RANGE via live.sbom (SBOM/dependency-CVE) and ACHIEVED_STATE via live.web_redrive — HEADER-DERIVED evidence only (3xx Location, CORS headers, OIDC via Location). Body-derived branches are not CLEAN-capable until the capture decodes Content-Encoding and the declared charset, and the JS-redirect branch is LEAD-only; no-channel is INCONCLUSIVE not CLEAN. Their proposer tools (trivy/grype, httpx) keep fact_capable=false by design.

tools.name: nmap
tools.notes: runner re-drives its own gated TCP handshake; service_reachable FACT. NPSL restricts commercial redistribution.

tools.name: sslscan
tools.notes: runner re-drives its own gated TLS handshake; weak_tls + weak_crypto_artifact FACTs. weak_tls is scoped to what a modern client still negotiates (honest).

tools.name: httpx
tools.notes: HTTP exposure is re-derived by VIGIL's live.web_redrive ACHIEVED_STATE path (no install): VIGIL issues its OWN gated, no-redirect capture and the deterministic predicate_oracle adjudicates — the tool is only a URL proposer, never the fact authority (fact_capable stays false). CAPABILITY BOUNDARY (honest, narrower than the family name): only HEADER-DERIVED evidence is FACT-capable today — a 3xx Location host, CORS reflected-origin-with-credentials, and an OIDC redirect proven through Location. BODY-DERIVED branches (meta-refresh / body redirect, host-header reflected into HTML) are NOT CLEAN-capable yet: the capture does not process Content-Encoding or the declared charset, so a gzip/Brotli or UTF-16 response decodes to replacement characters while the request still counts as an established channel — a body-dependent predicate could then return CLEAN over a document VIGIL never actually read. That is a realistic false-CLEAN on ordinary CDN infrastructure, not an exotic residual. The JS-redirect branch is LEAD-only (its regex still matches sinks inside JS comments and string literals, which needs a real JS tokenizer). Tracked as the next BLOCKING slice.
